framework.name: EU NIS 2 Directive (Directive (EU) 2022/2555)
framework.description: European Union Network and Information Security Directive 2 setting legal cybersecurity risk-management, supply chain, and incident notification mandates across critical essential and important sectors.

controls.title: Management Board Governance Approval & Risk Oversight
controls.description: Executive management bodies must formally approve cybersecurity risk-management measures, oversee implementation, and accept accountability for non-compliance under Article 20.
evidence_checklist: Executive Board Cybersecurity Policy Approval Minutes
Quarterly Risk Management Governance Review Minutes

controls.title: Mandatory Management Board Cybersecurity Training
controls.description: Members of the executive management body must follow regular mandatory cybersecurity training to gain sufficient knowledge and skills to assess risk management measures under Article 20.2.

controls.title: Information Systems Security Policy Framework
controls.description: Maintain documented, approved information security policies covering network systems, physical assets, cloud services, and operational environments per Article 21.2(a).

controls.title: Cyber Risk Assessment & Threat Modeling Methodology
controls.description: Perform periodic risk assessments, threat modeling, and business impact analysis to identify vulnerabilities in essential or important services.

controls.title: Automated Asset Discovery & Criticality Classification
controls.description: Maintain a real-time, automated inventory detailing all hardware, software, network interfaces, and cloud resources tied to critical business functions.

controls.title: Essential vs Important Entity Scope Mapping
controls.description: Formally classify organizational legal entities and operational units into Essential or Important categories according to Annex I and Annex II criteria.

controls.title: Incident Handling & Response Program Framework
controls.description: Establish an operational incident management framework detailing triage, containment, escalation, and post-incident review procedures.

controls.title: 24-Hour CSIRT Early Warning Notification SLA
controls.description: Enforce automated capability to issue an Early Warning incident notification to the CSIRT or competent authority within 24 hours of becoming aware of a significant incident.

controls.title: 72-Hour Detailed Incident Notification & Impact Report
controls.description: Submit a detailed incident notification report to the CSIRT within 72 hours, detailing initial severity assessment, indicators of compromise, and mitigation measures.
evidence_checklist: Threat Actor Indicator of Compromise (IoC) List

controls.title: 1-Month Final Incident Report Submission
controls.description: Submit a final comprehensive incident report to the CSIRT within 1 month of incident notification, detailing root cause, business impact, and corrective actions.

controls.title: Centralized SIEM & Tamper-Evident Audit Logging
controls.description: Maintain continuous, tamper-evident central logging across all servers, firewalls, and applications with central SIEM aggregation and 180-day retention.

controls.title: Immutable Off-Site Backup Management Policy
controls.description: Enforce automated, immutable off-site or air-gapped backups for all critical service databases and configurations with 24-hour frequency.

controls.title: Automated Disaster Recovery Testing & Validation
controls.description: Test disaster recovery systems and backup restoration quarterly, verifying data integrity and Recovery Time Objectives (RTO).

controls.title: Business Continuity & Crisis Management Plan
controls.description: Document, update, and test business continuity and crisis management plans annually to ensure operational resilience.

controls.title: High Availability & System Redundancy Architecture
controls.description: Deploy fault-tolerant system architecture with multi-region failover, redundant network links, and power backups for critical services.

controls.title: Supply Chain & Direct Supplier Security Assessment
controls.description: Assess the cybersecurity posture of direct suppliers, Cloud Service Providers (CSPs), and Managed Security Service Providers (MSSPs) prior to contracting.

controls.title: Software Bill of Materials (SBOM) & Third-Party Code Risk
controls.description: Maintain an automated Software Bill of Materials (SBOM) for all acquired software components to detect supply chain vulnerabilities and compromised libraries.

controls.title: Contractual Security Clauses & Breach Notification SLAs
controls.description: Incorporate binding security requirements into supplier contracts, including mandatory 24-hour incident disclosure, vulnerability remediation SLAs, and audit rights.

controls.title: Managed Service Provider (MSP/MSSP) Privileged Access Control
controls.description: Restrict and monitor third-party MSP/MSSP remote access using zero trust access proxy, just-in-time privilege elevation, and continuous session auditing.
evidence_checklist: MSP Access Control List & Jump Host Config

controls.title: Continuous Vulnerability Scanning & SLA Patch Remediation
controls.description: Perform continuous vulnerability scanning across network perimeters and hosts, enforcing remediation SLAs: critical vulnerabilities within 7 days, high within 14 days.

controls.title: Coordinated Vulnerability Disclosure (CVD) security.txt Policy
controls.description: Publish a Coordinated Vulnerability Disclosure policy and public security contact point (/well-known/security.txt) per RFC 9116.

controls.title: Network Micro-Segmentation & Boundary Isolation
controls.description: Segregate network zones into isolated segments (DMZ, Internal, Database, OT) using next-generation firewalls and strict default-deny ingress/egress rules.

controls.title: Secure Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) & SAST/DAST
controls.description: Integrate automated Static Application Security Testing (SAST) and Dynamic Testing (DAST) into CI/CD build pipelines prior to production deployment.

controls.title: Security Effectiveness Assessment & Penetration Testing
controls.description: Conduct annual independent penetration testing and quarterly automated compliance scans to evaluate control effectiveness under Article 21.2(f).

controls.title: Automated Configuration Compliance Auditing
controls.description: Schedule automated daily compliance engine scans against all OS endpoints and cloud environments to detect security policy drift.

controls.title: Regulatory Compliance Reporting & Authority Audit Preparedness
controls.description: Maintain audit-ready regulatory evidence ledgers and executive reports for inspection by EU National Competent Authorities under Article 32.

controls.title: OS Baseline Hardening & Configuration Hygiene
controls.description: Enforce baseline security configurations across all servers, endpoints, and network devices according to CIS Benchmarks.

controls.title: Password Complexity & Credential Hygiene Enforce
controls.description: Enforce strong password policy parameters (min 14 chars, complexity, dictionary block, max 90-day age) and disable default vendor passwords.
evidence_checklist: Active Directory / PAM Password Policy Export

controls.title: Employee Cybersecurity Awareness & Phishing Simulations
controls.description: Provide mandatory annual cyber hygiene training, phishing simulation exercises, and threat awareness modules for all personnel.

controls.title: Zero Trust Security Principles & Least Exposure
controls.description: Implement Zero Trust architecture principles (Never Trust, Always Verify) enforcing micro-perimeter isolation and continuous access verification.

controls.title: Data-in-Transit Encryption (TLS 1.3 / AES-256)
controls.description: Enforce strong TLS 1.2+ / TLS 1.3 encryption across all internal and external network communications, disabling legacy protocols (SSLv3, TLS 1.0, TLS 1.1) and weak ciphers.

controls.title: Data-at-Rest Volume & Database Encryption
controls.description: Encrypt sensitive data at rest using AES-256 or equivalent FIPS 140-3 validated cryptography across all volumes, storage buckets, and databases.

controls.title: Hardware Security Module (HSM) & Key Management Lifecycle
controls.description: Store encryption keys in dedicated Hardware Security Modules (HSMs) or Cloud KMS solutions with automated annual key rotation.

controls.title: SSH Key Rotation & Cryptographic Hygiene
controls.description: Enforce SSH key pair rotation every 90 days, disallowing weak RSA keys under 3072 bits and enforcing ED25519 or ECDSA algorithms.

controls.title: Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) & Least Privilege
controls.description: Enforce strict Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) limiting system access to minimum permissions required for business functions, with quarterly reviews.
evidence_checklist: User Directory Role & Group Assignment List

controls.title: Privileged Access Management (PAM) & Session Auditing
controls.description: Control and record all administrative logins and privileged sessions (SSH, RDP, sudo) via dedicated PAM solutions with session recording.

controls.title: Human Resources Security Onboarding & Offboarding
controls.description: Enforce HR security processes including background checks for sensitive roles and immediate revocation of access upon employee termination within 2 hours.

controls.title: Centralized Identity & Single Sign-On (SSO) Integration
controls.description: Centralize user authentication across enterprise and cloud systems using Single Sign-On (SSO) backed by SAML 2.0 or OpenID Connect (OIDC).

controls.title: Mandatory Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) Enforce
controls.description: Enforce mandatory Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) or continuous authentication for all user, administrative, remote VPN, and cloud access connections.
evidence_checklist: SSH Public-Key / Hardware Token Authentication Proof

controls.title: FIDO2 / WebAuthn Hardware Token Authentication for Admins
controls.description: Require phishing-resistant FIDO2 / WebAuthn hardware security keys (YubiKey) for all domain administrators and cloud root accounts.

controls.title: Secured Out-of-Band Crisis Voice, Video & Text Comms
controls.description: Deploy end-to-end encrypted communication tools for out-of-band crisis coordination and emergency incident command, independent of primary IT infrastructure.

controls.title: Secured Emergency Voice Bridge & Satellite Redundancy
controls.description: Maintain dedicated emergency satellite phone bridges or encrypted radio links for operational command centers during severe infrastructure outages.
